description.text: The second expansion of the XY series, released on 15 March 2014 together with the Mega Battle Deck 60 M Charizard-EX, both built around Charizard and Mega Charizard. M Charizard-EX made its debut in two forms, a Dragon type in this pack and a Fire type in the deck, each with an attack of 300 damage, the most the card game had seen. Kangaskhan-EX and M Kangaskhan-EX, Magnezone-EX and Toxicroak-EX join them, with evolved Pokémon whose Abilities support a deck. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 80, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-EX and Supporters and Ultra Rare cards of both M Charizard-EX and of M Kangaskhan-EX. In English most of its cards came out in Flashfire in May 2014.
